name: Apollonian Gasket
desc: A self-similar Apollonian gasket grown by the Descartes circle theorem, its mutually-tangent circles nesting into every curved gap and breathing depth-by-depth as gilded gold-leaf coins, neon rings, a cyan blueprint, misregistered riso duotone, or chiaroscuro spheres.

density.doc: recursion depth + pixel-floor: 0=few big coins, 1=hundreds of tiny ones (rebuilds, bucketed)

energy.doc: breathe/bloom amplitude, exposure, and bass response

speed.doc: reveal + breathe rate (beats-relative; K.t floor keeps it moving at 0)

scale.doc: outer disk radius vs min(w,h); 1.5 overflows the frame (rebuilds)

x.doc: gasket center x + light/glow direction (rebuilds, bucketed)

y.doc: gasket center y + light/glow direction (rebuilds, bucketed)

style.doc: render discipline: warm gilded coins / ADD glow rings / cyan drafting schematic / 2-ink misregistered print / form-from-light spheres

seed.doc: gasket layout + rotation (inline hash; rebuilds on change)

act.doc: dramaturgy: progressive depth unfurl / full-depth beat bloom / slow hue+radius breathing

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100=opaque bg; lower drops bg clear and thins fills)
